/bin/zsh -c "sed -n '621,900p' .agent-workflow/contracts/wayfinder-state.md && printf '\\n--- PROVIDERS ---\\n' && sed -n '1,320p' .agent-workflow/providers.json && printf '\\n--- VERIFICATION SKILL ---\\n' && sed -n '1,360p' .agents/skills/workflow-verification/SKILL.md && printf '\\n--- CURRENT DIFF ---\\n' && git diff -- terraform/main.tf docs/decisions/D1-runner-architecture.md .agent-wayfinder/eks-runner-infrastructure/map.md && printf '\\n--- CLAUDE ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' CLAUDE.md"

agent_validation_events.command:
/bin/zsh -c 'command -v terraform || true
terraform version 2>/dev/null || true
git status --short
git diff --check'

/bin/zsh -c 'rmdir .agent-wayfinder/eks-runner-infrastructure/unknowns 2>/dev/null || true
rmdir .agent-wayfinder/eks-runner-infrastructure/.wayfinder-mutation-lock
terraform fmt -check -diff
git diff --check
git status --short
git diff -- terraform/main.tf terraform/variables.tf terraform/outputs.tf .agent-wayfinder/eks-runner-infrastructure/map.md docs/decisions/D1-runner-architecture.md'

/bin/zsh -c "rmdir .agent-wayfinder/eks-runner-infrastructure/.wayfinder-mutation-lock
terraform fmt -check -diff
git diff --check
printf '\\n--- static acceptance checks ---\\n'
rg -n 'data \"aws_eks_cluster\" \"existing\"|data \"aws_ssm_parameter\" \"runner_ami\"|resource \"aws_launch_template\" \"runner\"|associate_public_ip_address = false|resource \"aws_eks_node_group\" \"runner\"|ami_type       = \"CUSTOM\"|instance_types = \\[var.runner_instance_type\\]|key    = \"dedicated\"|value  = \"ephemeral-ci-runner\"|effect = \"NO_SCHEDULE\"|scaling_config|runner_min_size <= var.runner_desired_size' terraform
printf '\\n--- final map ---\\n'
sed -n '1,220p' .agent-wayfinder/eks-runner-infrastructure/map.md
printf '\\n--- terraform validate (expected environment limitation) ---\\n'
terraform validate -no-color || true
printf '\\n--- final status ---\\n'
git status --short"
